description: Ground truth for demo/vulnerable-2026: the MCP vulnerability classes disclosed as CVEs or published attack techniques in 2025-2026, one clean instance each. demo/safe-2026 holds the fixed form of every file; anything reported there is a false positive. This corpus is scored separately from the 22-instance paper corpus, which is frozen.
unit_of_evaluation: one (file, category) pair; two instances of the same category in one file are listed separately when they sit on different lines

instances.what: DNS-rebinding protection explicitly disabled on the HTTP transport
tool fetches a caller-supplied URL with no host or private-address check
tool argument interpolated into a string given to asyncio.create_subprocess_shell
instances.mirrors: the shape of a third-party deliberately vulnerable fixture the previous rule set missed

instances.what: tool starts bash -lc on a caller-supplied string
instances.mirrors: shell-as-a-tool servers seen in the wild

instances.what: caller-supplied target passed to git without a -- separator
containment tested with a string prefix on an unresolved path
instances.mirrors: CVE-2025-66689 (Zen MCP), CVE-2025-53109 and CVE-2025-53110 (filesystem server)

instances.what: caller-shaped WHERE clause interpolated into a statement
HTTP transport bound to 0.0.0.0 with nothing in front of it
one StreamableHTTPServerTransport at module level shared by every client
imperative instructions inside a tool description, read before any call
instances.mirrors: Trail of Bits, Jumping the line (2025); Invariant Labs tool poisoning

instances.what: a description that gives orders about a different tool
zero-width characters carrying text a reviewer cannot see
caller-supplied target passed to execFile("git", ...) without --
